name: Gravity Mouse Trail
description: Images burst from the cursor as it moves, then fall under simulated gravity, bounce off the bottom of the viewport, and fade away.
usage: Drop in a positioned .gmt-stage element, then call initGravityMouseTrail(stageEl, { images: [...] }); pass an array of preloaded image URLs and the trail spawns from the cursor on mousemove.
